These forms select the named Health/F-prefix row in the snapshot; this does not assert the F-tag or scope code was positively extracted from the form. Raw correction categories, dates, cycle and flags are compared without adjudicating compliance, care quality, remediation time or causation. Correction-date minus survey-date is only calendar arithmetic over recorded fields. Distinct surveys are not superseding versions. Provider names, addresses, resident narratives and provider correction-plan text are excluded from quotes. All raw record first-publication facts retain the coarse 2026 proxy at confidence 0.25. Closed sets are named input cohorts, not census histories. A required pinned form has a provider-plan signature later than PRINTED; its publication metadata now uses only a low-confidence 2025 content-year estimate. First web availability is unproved; printed/survey facts and gold are unchanged.

notes: Root reviewed both institutional CCN/X3 selectors and each original CMS JSON object. These forms select the named Health/F-prefix row in the snapshot; this does not assert the F-tag or scope code was positively extracted from the form. Raw correction categories, dates, cycle and flags are compared without adjudicating compliance, care quality, remediation time or causation. Correction-date minus survey-date is only calendar arithmetic over recorded fields. Distinct surveys are not superseding versions. Provider names, addresses, resident narratives and provider correction-plan text are excluded from quotes. All raw record first-publication facts retain the coarse 2026 proxy at confidence 0.25. Closed sets are named input cohorts, not census histories. A required pinned form has a provider-plan signature later than PRINTED; its publication metadata now uses only a low-confidence 2025 content-year estimate. First web availability is unproved; printed/survey facts and gold are unchanged.

These forms select the named Health/F-prefix row in the snapshot; this does not assert the F-tag or scope code was positively extracted from the form. Raw correction categories, dates, cycle and flags are compared without adjudicating compliance, care quality, remediation time or causation. Correction-date minus survey-date is only calendar arithmetic over recorded fields. Distinct surveys are not superseding versions. Provider names, addresses, resident narratives and provider correction-plan text are excluded from quotes. All raw record first-publication facts retain the coarse 2026 proxy at confidence 0.25. Closed sets are named input cohorts, not census histories. A required pinned form has a provider-plan signature later than PRINTED; its publication metadata now uses only a low-confidence 2025 content-year estimate. First web availability is unproved; printed/survey facts and gold are unchanged.

notes: Root reviewed both institutional CCN/X3 selectors and each original CMS JSON object. These forms select the named Health/F-prefix row in the snapshot; this does not assert the F-tag or scope code was positively extracted from the form. Raw correction categories, dates, cycle and flags are compared without adjudicating compliance, care quality, remediation time or causation. Correction-date minus survey-date is only calendar arithmetic over recorded fields. Distinct surveys are not superseding versions. Provider names, addresses, resident narratives and provider correction-plan text are excluded from quotes. All raw record first-publication facts retain the coarse 2026 proxy at confidence 0.25. Closed sets are named input cohorts, not census histories. A required pinned form has a provider-plan signature later than PRINTED; its publication metadata now uses only a low-confidence 2025 content-year estimate. First web availability is unproved; printed/survey facts and gold are unchanged.

question: Use only these ten paired Health/F-prefix citation comparisons: CCN 435109, F0689, forms sd2567-20250102-0f44c1abb6 and sd2567-20250122-012f217be2; CCN 435104, F0657, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0658, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0812, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0880, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0689, forms sd2567-20250610-f06af86835 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435100, F0600, forms sd2567-20250618-d883568ba9 and sd2567-20260505-64befeb4f8; CCN 435054, F0812, forms sd2567-20250415-eda21fc15d and sd2567-20260128-5bc86b7447; CCN 435074, F0655, forms sd2567-20250522-24c0afea88 and sd2567-20251023-41756e5066; CCN 435127, F0689, forms sd2567-20251030-e72a59c2fb and sd2567-20260610-f5d447e56c. Select each snapshot row through its form X1/X3 headers. This closed cohort has 20 distinct CCN/survey/tag rows and 13 distinct forms; count rows or pairs as requested, not facilities or population outcomes. Calculate the sums and means of Correction Date minus Survey Date in days for the ten earlier and ten later rows, and the difference between means.
answer: Earlier sum 281 days, mean 28.1; later sum 386 days, mean 38.6. Difference later minus earlier: 10.5 days. Repeated facilities remain separate citation rows; these are recorded date intervals, not actual remediation durations.

notes: Root reviewed both institutional CCN/X3 selectors and each original CMS JSON object. These forms select the named Health/F-prefix row in the snapshot; this does not assert the F-tag or scope code was positively extracted from the form. Raw correction categories, dates, cycle and flags are compared without adjudicating compliance, care quality, remediation time or causation. Correction-date minus survey-date is only calendar arithmetic over recorded fields. Distinct surveys are not superseding versions. Provider names, addresses, resident narratives and provider correction-plan text are excluded from quotes. All raw record first-publication facts retain the coarse 2026 proxy at confidence 0.25. Closed sets are named input cohorts, not census histories. A required pinned form has a provider-plan signature later than PRINTED; its publication metadata now uses only a low-confidence 2025 content-year estimate. First web availability is unproved; printed/survey facts and gold are unchanged.

question: Use only these ten paired Health/F-prefix citation comparisons: CCN 435109, F0689, forms sd2567-20250102-0f44c1abb6 and sd2567-20250122-012f217be2; CCN 435104, F0657, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0658, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0812, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0880, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0689, forms sd2567-20250610-f06af86835 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435100, F0600, forms sd2567-20250618-d883568ba9 and sd2567-20260505-64befeb4f8; CCN 435054, F0812, forms sd2567-20250415-eda21fc15d and sd2567-20260128-5bc86b7447; CCN 435074, F0655, forms sd2567-20250522-24c0afea88 and sd2567-20251023-41756e5066; CCN 435127, F0689, forms sd2567-20251030-e72a59c2fb and sd2567-20260610-f5d447e56c. Select each snapshot row through its form X1/X3 headers. This closed cohort has 20 distinct CCN/survey/tag rows and 13 distinct forms; count rows or pairs as requested, not facilities or population outcomes. Calculate the median recorded correction-date-minus-survey-date interval separately for the ten earlier and ten later rows. Use the mean of the two central values.
answer: Earlier median 28 days. Later middle values are 37 and 39 days, giving median 38 days. Median difference is 10 days; units are calendar days of recorded-field arithmetic.

notes: Root reviewed both institutional CCN/X3 selectors and each original CMS JSON object. These forms select the named Health/F-prefix row in the snapshot; this does not assert the F-tag or scope code was positively extracted from the form. Raw correction categories, dates, cycle and flags are compared without adjudicating compliance, care quality, remediation time or causation. Correction-date minus survey-date is only calendar arithmetic over recorded fields. Distinct surveys are not superseding versions. Provider names, addresses, resident narratives and provider correction-plan text are excluded from quotes. All raw record first-publication facts retain the coarse 2026 proxy at confidence 0.25. Closed sets are named input cohorts, not census histories. A required pinned form has a provider-plan signature later than PRINTED; its publication metadata now uses only a low-confidence 2025 content-year estimate. First web availability is unproved; printed/survey facts and gold are unchanged.

question: Use only these ten paired Health/F-prefix citation comparisons: CCN 435109, F0689, forms sd2567-20250102-0f44c1abb6 and sd2567-20250122-012f217be2; CCN 435104, F0657, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0658, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0812, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0880, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0689, forms sd2567-20250610-f06af86835 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435100, F0600, forms sd2567-20250618-d883568ba9 and sd2567-20260505-64befeb4f8; CCN 435054, F0812, forms sd2567-20250415-eda21fc15d and sd2567-20260128-5bc86b7447; CCN 435074, F0655, forms sd2567-20250522-24c0afea88 and sd2567-20251023-41756e5066; CCN 435127, F0689, forms sd2567-20251030-e72a59c2fb and sd2567-20260610-f5d447e56c. Select each snapshot row through its form X1/X3 headers. This closed cohort has 20 distinct CCN/survey/tag rows and 13 distinct forms; count rows or pairs as requested, not facilities or population outcomes. Count pairs whose recorded correction-date interval increases, decreases or stays equal; also give the signed sum of all ten later-minus-earlier differences.

Raw correction categories, dates, cycle and flags are compared without adjudicating compliance, care quality, remediation time or causation. Correction-date minus survey-date is only calendar arithmetic over recorded fields. Distinct surveys are not superseding versions. Provider names, addresses, resident narratives and provider correction-plan text are excluded from quotes. All raw record first-publication facts retain the coarse 2026 proxy at confidence 0.25. Closed sets are named input cohorts, not census histories. A required pinned form has a provider-plan signature later than PRINTED; its publication metadata now uses only a low-confidence 2025 content-year estimate. First web availability is unproved; printed/survey facts and gold are unchanged.

notes: Root reviewed both institutional CCN/X3 selectors and each original CMS JSON object. These forms select the named Health/F-prefix row in the snapshot; this does not assert the F-tag or scope code was positively extracted from the form. Raw correction categories, dates, cycle and flags are compared without adjudicating compliance, care quality, remediation time or causation. Correction-date minus survey-date is only calendar arithmetic over recorded fields. Distinct surveys are not superseding versions. Provider names, addresses, resident narratives and provider correction-plan text are excluded from quotes. All raw record first-publication facts retain the coarse 2026 proxy at confidence 0.25. Closed sets are named input cohorts, not census histories. A required pinned form has a provider-plan signature later than PRINTED; its publication metadata now uses only a low-confidence 2025 content-year estimate. First web availability is unproved; printed/survey facts and gold are unchanged.

question: Use only these ten paired Health/F-prefix citation comparisons: CCN 435109, F0689, forms sd2567-20250102-0f44c1abb6 and sd2567-20250122-012f217be2; CCN 435104, F0657, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0658, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0812, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0880, forms sd2567-20250130-8615667bb8 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435104, F0689, forms sd2567-20250610-f06af86835 and sd2567-20251208-95346ba8dd; CCN 435100, F0600, forms sd2567-20250618-d883568ba9 and sd2567-20260505-64befeb4f8; CCN 435054, F0812, forms sd2567-20250415-eda21fc15d and sd2567-20260128-5bc86b7447; CCN 435074, F0655, forms sd2567-20250522-24c0afea88 and sd2567-20251023-41756e5066; CCN 435127, F0689, forms sd2567-20251030-e72a59c2fb and sd2567-20260610-f5d447e56c. notes: Root reviewed both institutional CCN/X3 selectors and each original CMS JSON object. These forms select the named Health/F-prefix row in the snapshot; this does not assert the F-tag or scope code was positively extracted from the form. Raw correction categories, dates, cycle and flags are compared without adjudicating compliance, care quality, remediation time or causation. Correction-date minus survey-date is only calendar arithmetic over recorded fields. Distinct surveys are not superseding versions. Provider names, addresses, resident narratives and provider correction-plan text are excluded from quotes. All raw record first-publication facts retain the coarse 2026 proxy at confidence 0.25. Closed sets are named input cohorts, not census histories. A required pinned form has a provider-plan signature later than PRINTED; its publication metadata now uses only a low-confidence 2025 content-year estimate. First web availability is unproved; printed/survey facts and gold are unchanged.

notes: Root reviewed both institutional CCN/X3 selectors and each original CMS JSON object. These forms select the named Health/F-prefix row in the snapshot; this does not assert the F-tag or scope code was positively extracted from the form. Raw correction categories, dates, cycle and flags are compared without adjudicating compliance, care quality, remediation time or causation. Correction-date minus survey-date is only calendar arithmetic over recorded fields. Distinct surveys are not superseding versions. Provider names, addresses, resident narratives and provider correction-plan text are excluded from quotes. All raw record first-publication facts retain the coarse 2026 proxy at confidence 0.25. Closed sets are named input cohorts, not census histories. A required pinned form has a provider-plan signature later than PRINTED; its publication metadata now uses only a low-confidence 2025 content-year estimate. First web availability is unproved; printed/survey facts and gold are unchanged.

notes: Root reviewed both institutional CCN/X3 selectors and each original CMS JSON object. These forms select the named Health/F-prefix row in the snapshot; this does not assert the F-tag or scope code was positively extracted from the form. Raw correction categories, dates, cycle and flags are compared without adjudicating compliance, care quality, remediation time or causation. Correction-date minus survey-date is only calendar arithmetic over recorded fields. Distinct surveys are not superseding versions. Provider names, addresses, resident narratives and provider correction-plan text are excluded from quotes. All raw record first-publication facts retain the coarse 2026 proxy at confidence 0.25. Closed sets are named input cohorts, not census histories. A required pinned form has a provider-plan signature later than PRINTED; its publication metadata now uses only a low-confidence 2025 content-year estimate. First web availability is unproved; printed/survey facts and gold are unchanged.
